name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.0 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 29 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 34 hours starting 2026-04-25, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.08 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
